title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

26-30k

Looking for your next step within HR?

This could be a great opportunity to step into a varied position where you'll work with businesses across a range of industries, helping them stay compliant and up to date with their HR documentation.

We're looking for someone with practical HR knowledge, strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with clients.

Day to Day
- Understanding each client's business, challenges and HR requirements.
- Advising clients on HR documentation and employment-related queries.
- Drafting bespoke HR documentation, including contracts, policies and handbooks.
- Keeping up to date with changes in employment legislation and best practice.
- Managing your own workload to meet agreed KPIs, SLAs and deadlines.
- Building strong, long-term relationships with clients through every interaction.
- Supporting existing clients with ongoing HR queries and documentation.
- Identifying opportunities to introduce relevant HR products and services.

YOU?
- Practical HR experience and a basic understanding of employment legislation.
- Someone confident communicating with clients and building rapport quickly.
- Strong written skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach.
- The ability to research and interpret HR legislation quickly.

This is a role where you'll be trusted to take ownership, work directly with clients and develop your HR knowledge from day one.

You'll receive ongoing training and development, regular employment law updates and a clear career pathway as you progress.

If you're looking for a role where you can combine HR knowledge, client interaction and problem-solving, this could be the next step for you.

title: Part-time HR Coordinator
description:
Part-Time HR Coordinator

Castle Donington

Approx. 22 Hours Per Week (3 days) - Primarily site-based with 1 day home working, and flexible working days

Are you an organised HR professional with exceptional IT skills? Do you enjoy improving processes, managing digital systems and using technology to create efficient ways of working?

We are seeking a Part-Time HR Coordinator to join a successful and growing business based in Castle Donington. Working approximately 22 hours across 3 days per week, this role offers flexibility around which days you work, making it ideal for those seeking a better work-life balance.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who combines strong HR administration experience with a high level of IT proficiency. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining HR systems, developing digital resources, supporting onboarding processes and helping to drive improvements across HR administration and employee communications.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the full administration process for new starters, leavers and employee changes
- Coordinating onboarding activities and preparing employment documentation
- Maintaining accurate HR records and employee data across HR systems
- Creating, developing and managing HR content within SharePoint and other digital platforms
- Supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems
- Producing HR reports, metrics and management information
- Managing employee communications, policies and HR documentation
- Supporting health & safety administration and compliance activities
- Providing general HR support to employees and managers

About You

This role will suit someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented and particularly comfortable working with technology.

Essential requirements:
- Previous experience in an HR Administration, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator position
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook
- Excellent IT literacy and confidence working with HR systems and databases
- Experience creating, updating and maintaining SharePoint sites, intranet content or digital employee resources
- Comfortable learning new software and introducing more efficient ways of working
- Experience managing onboarding documentation and employee records electronically
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion

What's on Offer?
- Part-time hours - approximately 22 hours per week
- 3 days per week with flexibility on working days
- Hybrid working with up to 1 day per week from home
- Varied and interesting HR role with broad responsibility
- Opportunity to make a real impact through process and system improvements
- Friendly and supportive working environment

This role is ideal for a HR professional who enjoys both the people and systems side of HR. If you're highly IT literate, enjoy building digital solutions such as SharePoint resources, and take pride in creating efficient HR processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Should you require any support or assistance, please contact your local Gi Group office.

title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Ideal recruit are looking for a Recruitment Resourcer to join our growing Industrial team in Leicester, supporting our clients and their operations.

This is a great opportunity to become part of a supportive team where you ll play a key role in helping clients find the right people for their warehouse operations.

What you ll be doing:
- Working closely with management to understand recruitment needs and client requirements
- Supporting our clients by delivering a high-quality recruitment service
- Sourcing candidates using a range of tools (CV databases, job boards, open days, etc.)
- Managing the full recruitment process, from initial contact through to onboarding
- Registering new candidates and ensuring all compliance is up to date
- Supporting the team with general recruitment administration

What we re looking for:
- A motivated and reliable individual with a positive attitude
- Someone proactive, organised, and responsive
- Ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- Willingness to learn and grow within a developing company

What we offer:
- Full-time
- Salary £25.842 - depending on experience
- Monday to Friday, 09 00
- Full training and resources provided to support your development

Requirements:
- Previous recruitment experience is desirable (minimum 6 months), but not essential
- Driving licence is required

If this sounds like a role for you, please apply with your up-to-date CV - we d love to hear from you!
